description: Receivers: Create a receiver; its receive URL and email address are shown once (rotate shows new ones). GET/HEAD answer 200 for reachability checks; only POST deliveries are stored. Free within your daily limit. Needs a hosted identity (create_identity).

allow_from.description: up to 8 source addresses or CIDR ranges; other senders are refused

dedupe_header.description: a header name up to 64 bytes, any case, such as X-Event-Id: a delivery repeating its value (up to 200 bytes) within 24 hours is answered as a duplicate and not stored or charged again. Without it nothing is deduplicated

hmac_secret.description: 16 to 256 printable characters: deliveries must carry X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, body)

label.description: your name for it, up to 64 bytes

max_cost.description: optional: your ceiling in credit; a higher price is refused, nothing spent. Default: the quote

request_id.description: optional retry key, unique among your commands: the same call again is never run or charged twice (the first answer within a minute, then 409 idempotency_conflict)

screen.description: screen each body for prompt injection (default true; the surcharge is what the classifier cost)

name: receiver_create
title: Receiver create
